SELECT c.name AS client_name, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.clients c
JOIN companyx.sales s ON c.id = s.client_id
WHERE c.region = '서울'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales
WHERE quarter = '2025-Q3'
SELECT AVG(s.amount) FROM companyx.sales s JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'security'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.contracts WHERE status = 'active'

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
JOIN companyx.departments d ON e.dept_id = d.id
WHERE d.name = '기술지원팀'
SELECT c.name FROM companyx.clients c JOIN companyx.projects p ON c.id = p.client_id WHERE p.status = 'in_progress' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY COUNT(p.id) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
SELECT title, description FROM companyx.support_tickets WHERE priority = 'critical' AND status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed')
SELECT p.name AS product_name, SUM(c.amount) AS total_contract_amount FROM companyx.products p JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM companyx.clients WHERE registered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND registered_at < '2025-01-01'
SELECT d.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM companyx.departments d JOIN companyx.employees e ON d.id = e.dept_id GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY avg_salary DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
JOIN companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE c.region = '부산' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2025 AND p.name LIKE '%장사%'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'security' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'cloud' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) THEN '보안'
        ELSE '클라우드'
    END AS category,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'security' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS security_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN p.category = 'cloud' THEN s.amount ELSE 0 END) AS cloud_revenue
FROM 
    companyx.sales s
JOIN 
    companyx.products p ON s.product_id = p.id
WHERE 
    s.region = '대전' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2025
SELECT (SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D1') - (SELECT price_monthly FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-D2') AS price_difference
SELECT name, version, release_date FROM companyx.products WHERE name = 'Product-C4'
SELECT c.contact_name, c.contact_email FROM companyx.clients c WHERE c.name = 'Client-N'
SELECT name, hire_date FROM companyx.employees WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM hire_date) = 2024 AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM hire_date) = 7

SELECT e.name, e.salary
FROM companyx.employees e
WHERE e.salary BETWEEN 4000 AND 5000 AND e.is_active

SELECT c.name AS client_name, st.title, st.created_at
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id
WHERE st.priority = 'critical' AND st.status = 'open'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, p.name AS product_name, st.title, st.created_at, st.resolved_at
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
JOIN companyx.clients c ON st.client_id = c.id
JOIN companyx.products p ON st.product_id = p.id
WHERE c.name = 'Client-X' AND st.title LIKE '%장애%'

SELECT st.title, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (st.resolved_at - st.created_at)) AS time_taken
FROM companyx.support_tickets st
WHERE st.status = 'resolved' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM st.resolved_at) = 2025
ORDER BY time_taken DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT c.name AS client_name, ct.end_date
FROM companyx.contracts ct
JOIN companyx.clients c ON ct.client_id = c.id
WHERE ct.end_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-11-01' AND ct.status = 'active'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, c.amount, c.start_date, c.end_date
FROM companyx.contracts c
JOIN companyx.products p ON c.product_id = p.id
WHERE c.client_id = (SELECT id FROM companyx.clients WHERE name = 'Client-B') AND c.contract_type = 'subscription'

SELECT p.name AS product_name, p.price_monthly, pr.budget AS product_budget, p.release_date, p.status, pr.name AS project_name, pr.start_date, pr.end_date, pr.budget AS project_budget, pr.description FROM companyx.products p
JOIN companyx.contracts c ON p.id = c.product_id
JOIN companyx.projects pr ON c.id = pr.contract_id
JOIN companyx.clients cl ON c.client_id = cl.id
WHERE p.name = 'Client-E 로그 분석 시스템'
SELECT name FROM companyx.projects WHERE status = 'on_hold' AND end_date IS NULL

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.region
FROM companyx.clients c
WHERE c.industry LIKE '%의료%' OR c.industry LIKE '%바이오%'

SELECT c.name AS client_name, c.registered_at
FROM companyx.clients c
ORDER BY c.registered_at ASC
LIMIT 5
SELECT T1.sale_date, T1.amount FROM companyx.sales AS T1 JOIN companyx.products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Product-S2' AND T1.quarter = '2025-Q1'
SELECT e.name, e.salary, e.hire_date FROM companyx.employees e WHERE e.name = '김준혁'

SELECT 
  contract_type, 
  COUNT(*) 
FROM 
  companyx.contracts 
WHERE 
  start_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' 
  AND status = 'cancelled' 
GROUP BY 
  contract_type

SELECT CASE WHEN s.quarter IN ('2026-Q1', '2026-Q2') THEN '상반기' ELSE '하반기' END AS half_year, SUM(s.amount) AS total_amount
FROM companyx.sales s
JOIN companyx.clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
WHERE c.region = '서울' AND s.quarter IN ('2026-Q1', '2026-Q2')
GROUP BY half_year
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES
